Name: Hired Help
Author: Yadm
Description:
[size=4][b]Hired Help[/b][/size]

Pay a neighbor to walk the farm and do the chores.

[youtube]l8PUpQu_01E[/youtube]
[line]

This is a late beta, version 0.9.0. Back up your save before you try it.

The daily work is a lot for one person. On Spring 4 of the first year, Mayor Lewis is waiting when you step outside. He tells you that you can post a notice and hire a neighbor for the next day, or for several days.

If that morning has already passed, or you add the mod to an older save, Lewis sends the same explanation by letter and the notice unlocks that day.

[heading]The notice[/heading]

The board opens from a button on your inventory, from a button on the Help Wanted page, and from the H key. Options can change that key.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url] is recommended. With it, the inventory button joins that column. Without it, the button keeps its own spot beside the inventory. Hired Help loads either way.

The board has five tabs: Notices, Planning, Chests, Log, and Saved orders.

On Notices you pick the person, the jobs, and the mornings. Save order keeps that person, those jobs, and those weekdays, so you can post the same set again. Saving does not spend gold, and an order does not renew on its own.

Planning chooses what a keg, a preserves jar, a seed maker, a dehydrator, and a cask may take. Gold and iridium are one switch under Machines, and it starts off. A machine that throws the star away leaves them in the chest until that switch is on.

Auto is a button on Notices. It starts off. At 8:00 PM it posts the next morning for as many people as the button shows, while a hire spot is open. If that hour is missed, it posts when the day ends. Each person gets the busiest work. A group of related jobs counts as one, and every job in that group that has work is included. An automatic notice pays the normal wage plus a flat 100g.

[heading]Who comes[/heading]

Linus, Alex, Sam, and Shane can be hired with no hearts. Abigail, Elliott, Haley, Leah, Emily, Maru, Marnie, and Robin need 2 hearts. Linus will come even if you have not talked to him. Everyone else has to have been met.

Haley will not clear weeds. Marnie and Robin close their shops on the days they work. Robin does not work on Tuesday. She can place one building from her shop instead of doing chores, and she does not walk over to hammer it. While she is still building, she cannot be hired.

Two people can be hired at once. Options can change that, from one to six. A person who already works one morning can still be hired for the others.

[heading]Pay and the day[/heading]

Gold is paid when you post the notice. Before 8:00 PM, the person comes the next morning. At 8:00 PM or later, they come the morning after that. That cutoff can be turned off, and then the next morning stays open all day.

You can hire up to 7 mornings at a time, unless you change that limit. Pay is only the mornings you check. Those mornings can repeat every week. You pay them now, and the same weekdays are bought again next week. A morning that is closed is skipped and not charged.

They walk onto the farm at 8:00 AM. You see them cross the field and go into a barn or a shed when the job is inside. They work eight hours from the time they reach the farm. Without overtime they leave when those hours end, and leftover crops stay. With overtime they stay until 2:00 AM. If you sleep while they are still out, leftover watering, harvesting, planting, and greenhouse keeping are finished only when overtime was paid. Other work stays where it is. They are sent home, so a save does not leave them in the field.

A rainy day skips outdoor watering and returns that part of the wage. Greenhouse keeper still waters inside. A festival that closes the town returns that day's wage, and nobody is pulled off the festival. A night market or a desert festival is not a day off.

Cancel a notice before 8:00 AM on the start day for a full refund. After they have started, that day is spent and the remaining days are returned.

If someone cannot come, the log says why, and that day's gold is returned. On their birthday they can stay home. That option starts on, the day stays paid, and that morning can go to someone else.

The Log tab shows what you paid and what they brought in.

[heading]The work[/heading]

One notice is one place. The farm covers the farm, its buildings, and the greenhouse. After the island parrot, Ginger Island is its own notice: the west farm and the buildings on it, with a 1000g trip each day on top of the wages.

The jobs cover watering, hoeing, planting, fertilizer, Speed-Gro, retaining soil, harvesting, the greenhouse, animals, machines, weeds, stones, twigs, farm forage, tappers, fruit trees, hay, the pet bowl, and cutting grown trees.

A new notice leaves planting off. Checking it turns on hoeing, watering, and planting. Fertilizer, Speed-Gro, and retaining soil stay off until you check them. Seeds come from a Supply chest. A field with no sprinkler is not hoed.

Animals covers petting, feeding, and collecting what they produce. Machines are filled from a Supply chest and emptied when they are ready. They also empty a machine that only leaves an item, such as a bee house or a lightning rod. They fill a cask where the game ages one.

Jobs that move items need a chest. Each chest is Supply or Storage, and every extra chest starts as Storage. Supply is where you put seeds, fertilizer, ore, coal, wood, and hay. Storage receives the goods. You can tag a chest, for vegetables, ore, or the other groups. The drop-off chest is always Storage.

You gain a share of the normal experience from their work, 20 percent unless you change it. A day they finish a job they are good at also gives a little friendship.

[heading]Languages[/heading]

The words follow the game's language.

[list]
[*]Chinese[/*]
[*]Portuguese[/*]
[*]Russian[/*]
[*]Spanish[/*]
[*]Japanese[/*]
[*]Korean[/*]
[*]German[/*]
[*]French[/*]
[/list]
English is the fallback when a line has no translation. There is no language picker in the mod. Set the language in the game.

[heading]Options[/heading]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional. With it you can change the wages, the friendship gain, the experience percent, how many people you can hire, how long a contract can run, whether they stay home on their birthday, the H key, how many jobs an automatic notice includes, whether an idle overtime hire walks home, and whether items from other mods are colored. Job priority is its own page. With farming-level scaling on, each farming level adds 10 percent to the wage.

Without that menu, the mod uses its defaults. After the first launch, edit Mods/HiredHelp/config.json while the game is closed.

[heading]Requirements[/heading]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url] is optional. It lines the inventory button up with the others.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional. It only adds the in-game options.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Installation[/heading]

[list]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this download into Stardew Valley/Mods, or install the zip with Vortex.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
The mod folder should look like this:

[code]
Mods/HiredHelp/
  HiredHelp.dll
  manifest.json
  README.md
  i18n/default.json
  i18n/zh.json
  i18n/pt.json
  i18n/ru.json
  i18n/es.json
  i18n/ja.json
  i18n/ko.json
  i18n/de.json
  i18n/fr.json[/code]
config.json appears after the first launch. Back up your save. This is a late beta.

[heading]Uninstall[/heading]

Cancel the notice and sleep before you remove the mod, so the hired people are home.

If the mod is removed while someone is still out, they stay there until the mod is put back and the save is loaded.

Remove the HiredHelp folder from Stardew Valley/Mods, or uninstall it in Vortex. There is no item to take out of your inventory.

[heading]Compatibility[/heading]

The board and the work run for the host. A farmhand does not get them.

The same walk is used on the standard farms and on Frontier Farm from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Most of the testing was on Frontier Farm. Hired Help does not require Stardew Valley Expanded, and it does not need Content Patcher. Another mod can register one more place for a notice.

You can still do the chores yourself. The notice only covers the jobs you checked.

Easy Access Buttons and Generic Mod Config Menu are optional. Hired Help loads without either of them. Machines and items from other mods can show on the board, in blue when that option is on. It starts on, and it adds no dependency. Those machines and items have not been tested.

While a neighbor is hired, Hired Help walks them and pauses their schedule. Another mod that moves that same person, or replaces their schedule, can pull them off the work. Their schedule resumes when the day ends. That clash has not been tested.

by Yadm

After you reach floor 100 of the Mines, Marlon writes. Visit the guild and he adds the monster eradication list to your inventory.

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53287]Perfection Shortcut[/url][/b]

by Yadm

After Qi's Walnut Room unlocks, a button on your inventory opens the perfection tracker. It shows the same progress as the room, and it does not change your score.

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53144]Staircase Spacing[/url][/b]

by Yadm

Stops a staircase from being placed in the Mines or Skull Cavern when a ladder is already nearby. The staircase stays in your inventory.
